newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-OLYMPIAKOS GRAB LATE VICTORY OVER STEFANEL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-OLYMPIAKOS GRAB LATE VICTORY OVER STEFANEL.

text.p: Olympiakos made sure on Thursday of their place in the last 16 of the EuroLeague basketball tournament, beating group E leaders Stefanel 87-84 in a last-gasp thriller.
With 10 seconds to go Stefanel led 84-83 and attacked to finish off the Greeks but a clumsy foul by Alessandro de Pol handed Olympiakos forward Franko Nakic two successful free throws.

The Italian bench strongly protested the foul and were penalised with two more free throws. Olympiakos captain George Sigalas converted both giving the Greeks the precious victory to the delight of the 10,000 home fans.
"We are in the playoffs and the real test begins now," Olympiakos' Serb coach Dusan Ivcovic said. "It was a thriller match that should have not developed this way."

The Greeks seemed to be up for an easy night leading 51-39 at halftime with Serb forward Dragan Tarlac (23 points) dominating the boards and American playmaker David Rivers (25) scoring at will from outside the D.
But the Italian defence closed in on Tarlac in the second half confining him to only seven points while his personal guard Gregor Fucka (20 points) led the Italian recovery.
With six minutes to go and Stefanel ahead by three points, Fucka fouled out and the match then developed into a thrilling point-to-point encounter until the end.
Stefanel's usual top gun, American forward Warren Kidd, had a bad night with only 15 points, well below his average.
But with an 11-4 record to day. Stefanel are still clear of the group and safely in the last 16.
